command: npx vitest run <the mutant's test files> --reporter=json --outputFile=<tmp>
method: Each mutant replaces one fragment (`old`, occurring exactly once in `file`) with `new`, runs the listed test files with vitest, counts the mutant killed when the run exits non-zero, records the failed tests, and restores the file byte for byte (checked against `subject`). Rule 6, AGENTS.md.
